summary: 10 m of kerb at a side-street mouth on a main road.
reasons: Junction mouth, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 13 m from the start; cleared lot to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Line sits across the mouth of Stanley Terrace where it meets the main road; stopping would block the junction.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial just south, with a dashed give-way line.
drivers.convention: Cars park further up the side street, but not at the junction.

flags: Steep: about 11% on DEM over 10 m, at the junction
sun_shade: Open; trees to the east and south-west.
